title: Engine: debt moved between cards by a card-to-card transfer is never charged by the uncategorized rollover
description: Found in the budget-xxpr review, deliberately NOT fixed there. The rollover charge is computed per card from that card's own uncategorized card legs (ledger.cardOut / uncatCardNet), capped by what its envelope does not cover. A card-to-card transfer is not an uncategorized spending leg, so debt moved from card A to card B is only ever charged on A's month (if A had uncategorized spending) and never on B, whose debt grew without any uncategorized transaction. Whoever picks this up should decide whether the charge follows the card that carries the debt or the card that spent it.
